newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Electronic Resources directors sell stock.
newsitem.headline: Electronic Resources directors sell stock.

text.p: Three directors of electronics components distributor Electronic Resources Ltd sold a total of 10 million shares at Singapore S$1.40 each on Thursday, said a company official.
The shares, which amounted to 7.5 percent of the company, were placed to institutional investors, the official said.
The three directors are Tong Kok Chiang, who is also the company's executive chairman, Denis Low and Foo Lai Fuan.
The three still hold 57 million shares or about 42.5 percent of the company, said the official.
